research_question: Can a fixed two-F37 placement reach and sustain the unchanged qualified sand-health state when equilibration is judged by consecutive passing blocks rather than one arbitrarily chosen terminal block?
claim_boundary: Dry fixed-fibre equilibration-method development and one held-out geometry confirmation only. No free fibre motion, promoted DEM state, polymer calibration, permeability, flow, deformation, migration, or coupled physics.

evidence_roles.development: Revision-3 candidate01 and its Stage26c failure history may be used to design and test this equilibration procedure.
evidence_roles.controls: The Stage26a positive and Stage26b negative placements remain protocol controls.
evidence_roles.held_out_confirmation: Revision-3 candidate04 is selected before Stage26d execution because it is the next-lowest-index independently verified passing geometry. It must not influence protocol tuning.

frozen_protocol.stop_rule_interpretation: The raw runner executes the full ceiling for immutable comparability; the evaluator reports the earliest qualifying 10-block window and does not discard later data.

unchanged_physics: F37 rigid clump geometry, mass, density, stiffness, friction, and fixed kinematics
100 Pa isotropic target, zero gravity, damping 0.35, timestep safety 0.2, maximum controller rate 0.02 s^-1
exact two-contact insertion and all Stage26c sand-health thresholds
sequential_handoff: candidate01 development only if both controls reproduce
candidate04 held-out confirmation once only if candidate01 passes without changing the frozen design

failure_rules.resource_ceiling: No qualifying window by block 300 is a non-equilibration failure.
failure_rules.engagement: Any isolated fibre or loss of all declared anchors at any block is a geometry-engagement failure.
failure_rules.confirmation: A held-out failure closes Stage26d; the same confirmation case cannot be reused as independent evidence after redesign.
